verdict.rationale: Refunds are a fair axis for an agentic payments and checkout product, but nothing in the evidence documents an API to initiate or track refunds on agent-placed orders. The closest items are an auth-hold and dispute-handling note for the general Checkout product, the ability to cancel unspent order intents, and generic order-lifecycle webhooks. None of these is a programmatic refund flow, and the agent checkout lifecycle is poll-only with no webhooks in v1.
